raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
_(the text below is written by myself)_

This is an effort to (1) increase standardization and (2) limit LoC changes in model files as a result from adding numerous specialized decode kernels (_aka "monokernels"_). 

The kernels themselves will naturally remain difficult to review thoroughly, but ideally model code should remain easy to review. The abstraction layer should deliberately be made as thin as possible,

Heavily inspired by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61867, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/60904.

**Note: this PR drops `--monokernel` in favor of `--specialized-decode`**

# 1. Goal

**An author of a specialized decode kernel should write:**

1. A FlyDSL/CuTeDSL implementation and its utilities, in `vllm/models/<model>/<vendor>/`
2. The conditions under which it can run
3. Minimal glue connecting it to the model code

**The author should not have to write:**

1. Another new way to glue the kernel into the model code
3. Basic config checks during start up, re-used by many specialized kernels needs anyway (parallelism, spec decode, graph mode)
4. Checks of whether to run the specizlied kernel or regular vllm code at every step
5. TP rank agreement of the above
6. Updating of CUDA graph capture sizes
7. Kernel selection when one model has more than one specialized kernel
8. Optional: JIT/warm-up registration


This PR implements the latter points.

# 2. How

Declare when the specialized kernel can run:
```python
# refuse causes crash, skip causes fallback to regular vllm execution

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DecodeSpec(Generic[KernelT]):
    name: str
    supports: frozenset[Feature]
    widths: Callable[[VllmConfig], tuple[int, ...]]
    refuse_config: Callable[[VllmConfig], list[str]]
    refuse_model: Callable[[Any], list[str]]
    refuse_caches: Callable[[VllmConfig, KernelT, Mapping[str, Any]], list[str]]
    skip_step: Callable[[VllmConfig, KernelT, int], str | None]
    build: Callable[[VllmConfig, Any, tuple[int, ...]], KernelT]
```

`KernelT` is a stand-in for the entire model forward, implementing

```python
class DecodeImpl(Protocol):
    cache_layers: tuple[str, ...]

    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any: ...
    def bind_caches(self, caches: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None: ...
```

**Optional:** A kernel that compiles its launches from keys (one per width, per layer plan, or whatever the kernel keys on) can additionally implement

```python
@runtime_checkable
class DecodeWarmable(Protocol):
    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]: ...
    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None: ...
```

which will cause the dispatcher to auto-register it for warmup. The existing DSv41 implementation uses this, and so would https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60889, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60731, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60683. The Kimi K3 nvidia kernel jits eagerly since its specialized decode kernel is not created in a region with an active jit registry; hence, this feature is optional.

Once the kernel author has written their CuteDSL/FlyDSL kernel, the two remaining points

> 2. The conditions under which it can run
> 3. Minimal glue connecting it to the model code

is implemented through a Spec and wiring the kernel code through a DecodeImpl. The remainder is taken place by the shared `SpecializedDecode` utility.

_Note: we deliberately put no further constraint on how one implements `run`. There is a big benefit letting each model decide exactly how to structure this. We've already seen many different ways of structuring the underlying flydsl/cutedsl kernels._

## 2.1 Model-side code

The model-side code will look like this:

```python
class MyForCausalLM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config, prefix=""):
        self.decode_spec = select_decode_spec(vllm_config, SPECS)
        self.specialized_decode: SpecializedDecode[MyKernel] | None = None

    def process_weights_after_loading(self):
        # optionally: this code can also be placed in the model state init, but then you cannot benefit from auto-registration of warmup
        if self.decode_spec is not None:
            self.specialized_decode = SpecializedDecode(
                self.model, self.vllm_config, self.decode_spec
            )

    def forward(self, input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors=None, inputs_embeds=None, **kwargs):
        decode = self.specialized_decode
        if decode is not None:
            step = decode.plan(positions, intermediate_tensors)
            if step is not None:
                return decode.run(step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)
        return self.model(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)
```

plus one hook to prepare the kv cache

```python
class MyModelState(DefaultModelState):
    def initialize_kv_cache(self, kv_cache_config, block_tables):
        super().initialize_kv_cache(kv_cache_config, block_tables)
        if self.model.specialized_decode is not None:
            self.model.specialized_decode.bind_caches()
```

On the model side nothing else needs to be touched. 

# 3. How to: adding a second kernel for the same model

Say DSv4.1 gets a gfx942 kernel next to the gfx950 one. Write the FlyDSL kernel, then:

```python
# vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/specialized_decode.py

class DSV41Gfx942Kernel(DSV41Kernel):           # reuse what you want
    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any: ...
        ...
        return self.runner.run_gfx942_kernel(...)

    def compile(self, key):
        width, idx = key
        self.runner.kernels(width, self.plans[idx])


def _refuse_config_gfx942(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
    reasons = []
    if not current_platform.is_gfx942():
        reasons.append("needs a gfx942 GPU")
    ...
    return reasons


DECODE_SPEC_GFX942 = DecodeSpec[DSV41Gfx942Kernel](
    name="dsv41-cdna3",
    supports=frozenset({Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL}),   # no spec decode here
    widths=lambda cfg: tuple(range(1, 17)),            # fewer rows than gfx950
    refuse_config=_refuse_config_gfx942,
    refuse_model=_refuse_model,                        # shared with gfx950
    refuse_caches=_refuse_caches,
    skip_step=_skip_step,
    build=DSV41Gfx942Kernel,
)

SPECS = (DECODE_SPEC_GFX950, DECODE_SPEC_GFX942)
```

Then one line in the model:

```python
self.decode_spec = select_decode_spec(vllm_config, SPECS)
```

The dispatcher takes the first compatible spec. Specializing on something other than arch works the same way. A hyper-specialized batch-size 1 kernel can just set `widths= lambda cfg: (1,)` and be placed first in the `SPECS` list.

# 4. How to: a kernel that only covers part of a layer

A specialized decode kernel might cover only part of a layer, e.g. only o-proj through post-moe AR.

The common dispatcher has no concept of this, and does not need one, because the kernel owns the layer loop. Hence it can decide at every layer whether to run it as a single monokernel, or to run it in the regular vllm model code. 

When we run part of a layer as a specialized kernel, we simply run the regular vllm model code and _inject_ the specialized kernel:

```python
class DSV41Kernel:
    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
        self.model.prologue(input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)
        ....
        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
            layer, plan = model.layers[idx], self.plans.get(...)
            ffn = out = None
            if plan.ffn_only:
                ffn = partial(self.launch_ffn, plan)      # a part of a layer
            else:
                out = self.launch_whole(plan, hidden, positions, ...)
            if out is None:
                out = layer(hidden, positions, ..., decode_ffn=ffn) # run regular vllm and inject
            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix = out
        ...
```

```python
class DeepseekV4DecoderLayer(nn.Module):

    def forward(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        ...
        decode_ffn: Callable | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        ... # run pre etc
        x = self.attn(positions, x, None)
        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
            x = sp_reduce_scatter(x)
        elif not self.attn.wo_b.reduce_results:
            # run the "partial-layer specialized decode kernel"
            if decode_ffn is not None:
                out = decode_ffn(x, residual, post_mix, res_mix, attn_pre)
                if out is not None:
                    return out

```

## 5. Add specialized decode support for a drafter

See the DSv41 code for an example. It's treated basically identically as to another other regular model.

# Validation

# 1. DeepSeek-v41 on MI350

On MI350, force max 8 seqs
```
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --language-model-only \
  --max-model-len 8192 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype=mxfp4 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --moe-backend aiter \
  --speculative-config "{\"method\":\"dspark\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":5}" \
  [--specialized-decode]
```

  --base-url http://localhost:8000 \

+of the output rank's peer buffer. A rank whose wait gives up writes its word
+there, drains the store, then sets FAILED, so nothing it stores later can
+overtake the flag. The runner reads these words after every step.

+from vllm.models.common.mono.spec import Feature, MonoSpec
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.rocm import DeepseekV4ROCMAiterSparseSWAMetadata
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+SPECS_PATH = "vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono_spec:MONO_SPECS"
+
+RECORD = 584  # an fp8_ds_mla KV record: 576 data bytes, 8 scale bytes
+SWA_WIDTH = 128  # a causal decode token's window slots
+MAX_ROWS = 48  # the kernels' step rows at most: 8 requests x (1 + 5 DSpark drafts)
+# the kernels' ISA: CDNA4 (gfx950) scaled MFMA and MX formats
+CDNA_VERSIONS = (4,)
+
+
+def _record_view(kv: torch.Tensor, block: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A layer's fp8_ds_mla cache as [blocks, block, RECORD] bytes (a block's
+    data rows, then its scale words: the kernels index both from it)."""
+    kv = kv if kv.dtype == torch.uint8 else kv.view(torch.uint8)
+    return torch.as_strided(kv, (kv.shape[0], block, RECORD), (kv.stride(0), RECORD, 1))
+
+
+def _scale_bytes(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return scale if scale.dtype == torch.uint8 else scale.view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _select(
+    layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer",
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    normed: torch.Tensor,
+    qr: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """An index source's compressor and top-k selection, from K1's normed input
+    and bf16 qr: ``_forward_csa2_full`` / ``_forward_csa2_reindex`` and the
+    indexer op, serial."""
+    attn = layer.attn
+    comp, indexer = attn.compressor, attn.indexer
+    assert indexer is not None
+    if comp is not None:
+        kv_score = torch.mm(
+            normed, comp.fused_wkv_wgate.weight.T, out_dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        latent = comp(kv_score, positions)
+        comp.insert_cache(latent, positions, attn.rotary_emb)
+        indexer._produce_k(latent, positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb)
+    weights, _ = indexer.weights_proj(normed)
+    q, q_scale, weights = indexer.forward_q(
+        qr, None, weights, positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb
+    )
+    assert weights is not None
+    indexer.indexer_op(
+        normed, (q, q_scale) if q_scale is not None else q, None, weights
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LaunchState:
+    """What this rank's launches hold across every step: the runner (one a
+    rank, its peer memory collective over the TP group), the error words, each
+    kernel layer's weight views, and the metadata keys ``skip_step`` validates
+    for every kernel layer at once.
+
+    Built once at attach and never moved: the kernels and the captured graphs
+    hold its addresses.
+    """
+
+    runner: Any
+    embed_layer: int
+    words: torch.Tensor
+    weights: dict[int, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    swa_keys: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    comp_keys: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    need_swa: bool = False
+
+
+class DSV41LayerKernel:
+    """The ``LayerKernel`` both launches implement: the layer, its width and
+    its weight views, with the launch shape left to the subclass."""
+
+    ffn_only = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, launch_state: LaunchState, layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer", width: int
+    ):
+        self.launch_state = launch_state
+        self.layer = layer
+        self.width = width
+        self.weights = launch_state.weights[layer.attn.layer_id]
+        self.cache_layers: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def launch(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Any:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class WholeLayer(DSV41LayerKernel):
+    """The whole backbone layer as K1 and K2, from the layer's own inputs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, launch_state: LaunchState, layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer", width: int
+    ):
+        super().__init__(launch_state, layer, width)
+        attn = layer.attn
+        self.ratio = attn.compress_ratio
+        self.index = attn.indexer is not None
+        self.swa_key = attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix
+        self.comp_key = attn.compressed_cache_prefix
+        self.cache_layers = (self.swa_key,) + (
+            (self.comp_key,) if self.comp_key is not None else ()
+        )
+        # K1's seam folds the owed post into the residual, except where the
+        # residual arrives settled: the embedding, or after the Engram write.
+        settled = attn.layer_id == launch_state.embed_layer or layer.engram is not None
+        self.folds = (True, False) if settled else (True,)
+
+    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]:
+        return [(self.width, self.ratio, f, self.index) for f in self.folds]
+
+    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None:
+        width, ratio, fold, index = key
+        self.launch_state.runner.scratch(width)
+        self.launch_state.runner.kernels(width, ratio, fold=fold, index=index)
+
+    def launch(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+        post_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+        res_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+        pre_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+        engram_hashes: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        engram_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None:
+        layer, attn = self.layer, self.layer.attn
+        runner = self.launch_state.runner
+        first = residual is None
+        if first and x.dim() != 2:
+            return None
+        tensors = (x,) if first else (x, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix)
+        if not all(t is not None and t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors):
+            return None
+        fold = True
+        if first:
+            residual = x.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, layer.hc_mult, -1).contiguous()
+            pre_mix = runner.first_pre_mix(x.shape[0])
+            post_mix = res_mix = pre_mix  # unread without the fold
+            fold = False
+        elif layer.engram is not None and engram_hashes is not None:
+            residual = layer.mhc_post(x, residual, post_mix, res_mix)
+            hashes = engram_hashes[:, layer.engram.layer_hash_index]
+            residual = layer.engram(residual, hashes, engram_mask)
+            fold = False
+        md = cast("dict[str, Any]", get_forward_context().attn_metadata)
+        swa = md[self.swa_key]
+        kw: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        if self.index:
+            kw["select"] = lambda normed, qr: _select(layer, positions, normed, qr)
+        if self.ratio:
+            comp = md[cast("str", self.comp_key)]
+            kw.update(
+                topk_indices=attn.topk_indices_buffer,
+                comp_cache=_record_view(
+                    attn._compressed_kv_cache(), comp.block_size // self.ratio
+                ),
+                comp_block_table=comp.block_table,
+            )
+        return runner.forward(
+            self.weights,
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_mix,
+            res_mix,
+            pre_mix,
+            positions,
+            swa.slot_mapping,
+            _record_view(attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache, swa.block_size),
+            swa.decode_swa_indices,
+            swa.decode_swa_lens,
+            swa.token_to_req_indices,
+            fold=fold,
+            **kw,
+        )
+
+
+class FfnSeam(DSV41LayerKernel):
+    """The FFN seam, MoE and both reductions as one launch, from wo_b's
+    unreduced output after vLLM's attention."""
+
+    ffn_only = True
+
+    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]:
+        return [(self.width, "ffn")]
+
+    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None:
+        self.launch_state.runner.scratch(key[0])
+        self.launch_state.runner.ffn_kernel(key[0])
+
+    def launch(
+        self,
+        part: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        post_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        res_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        pre_mix: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None:
+        tensors = (part, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix)
+        if not all(t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors):
+            return None
+        return self.launch_state.runner.ffn(self.weights, *tensors)
+
+
+def _compute_units() -> int:
+    return current_platform.num_compute_units(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+
+
+def _widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """The configured capture sizes the kernels can serve, so a deployment
+    that asked for fewer graphs keeps them; every size at all when it asked for
+    none."""
+    sizes = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or []
+    served = tuple(s for s in sorted(sizes) if 1 <= s <= MAX_ROWS)
+    return served or tuple(range(1, MAX_ROWS + 1))
+
+
+def _refuse_config(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this config cannot run the kernels, before load."""
+    reasons = []
+    if vllm_config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size not in (2, 4):
+        reasons.append("needs tensor parallel size 2 or 4")
+    if envs.VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4:
+        reasons.append(
+            "needs AITER's A8W4 MoE (VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4 unset)"
+        )
+    try:
+        import vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono.runner  # noqa: F401
+    except ImportError as err:
+        reasons.append(f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({err})")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def _refuse_model(model) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason the loaded model and this GPU cannot run the kernels. The
+    kernels read every one of the 384 experts on each rank, TP-sharded, in
+    AITER's A8W4 MXFP4 layout, from CTAs that all stay resident."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.mono.runner import BLOCKS
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    reasons = []
+    if get_cdna_version() not in CDNA_VERSIONS:
+        reasons.append(f"needs CDNA{'/'.join(map(str, CDNA_VERSIONS))}")
+    cus = _compute_units()
+    if cus < BLOCKS:
+        reasons.append(f"needs {BLOCKS} compute units, the GPU has {cus}")
+    backends = set()
+    for layer in model.layers:
+        experts = getattr(getattr(layer, "ffn", None), "experts", None)
+        routed = getattr(experts, "routed_experts", None)
+        if routed is not None:
+            backends.add(getattr(routed.quant_method, "mxfp4_backend", None))
+    wrong = backends - {Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16}
+    if wrong:
+        reasons.append(f"needs the AITER_MXFP4_BF16 MoE backend, not {wrong}")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def _skip_layer(layer) -> str | None:
+    """Why this layer keeps vLLM's path for every step, or None when it takes a
+    launch (whole or FFN only: ``_build`` picks which)."""
+    ffn = layer.ffn
+    if layer.use_sequence_parallel:
+        return "sequence-parallel layer"
+    if not layer.fuse_seam_norm:
+        return "needs aiter's fused mHC seam"
+    if (
+        ffn.shared_experts is None
+        or ffn.gate.tid2eid is not None
+        or ffn.n_routed_experts != 384
+        or ffn.n_activated_experts != 6
+        or ffn.routed_scaling_factor != 1.5
+        or ffn.swiglu_limit != 10.0
+        or ffn.scoring_func != "sqrtsoftplus"
+        or not ffn.renormalize
+    ):
+        return "MoE routing outside the kernels' (384 / 6, sqrtsoftplus, x1.5)"
+    return None
+
+
+def _ffn_only(layer) -> str | None:
+    """Why this layer's attention seam and attention stay on vLLM's path, which
+    leaves it the FFN launch, or None when it runs whole."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.rocm import DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+
+    attn = layer.attn
+    if attn.compressor is not None and attn.indexer is None:
+        return "a compressor without an indexer"
+    if attn.indexer is not None and not isinstance(
+        attn.indexer, DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+    ):
+        return f"a {type(attn.indexer).__name__}"
+    if attn.compress_ratio not in (0, 1, 2):
+        return f"compress ratio {attn.compress_ratio}"
+    if attn.kv_mxfp8 or attn.kv_cache_dtype != "fp8_ds_mla":
+        return f"a {attn.kv_cache_dtype} KV cache"
+    return None
+
+
+def _skip_step(vllm_config, launch_state: LaunchState, width: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this step keeps vLLM's path at every layer, or None when the kernels
+    take it. One verdict for every kernel layer, from the batch the whole TP
+    group sees alike."""
+    fc = get_forward_context()
+    md = fc.attn_metadata

detail.body:
_(the text below is written by myself)_

This is an effort to (1) increase standardization and (2) limit LoC changes in model files as a result from adding numerous specialized decode kernels (_aka "monokernels"_). 

The kernels themselves will naturally remain difficult to review thoroughly, but ideally model code should remain easy to review. The abstraction layer should deliberately be made as thin as possible,

Heavily inspired by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61867, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/60904.

**Note: this PR drops `--monokernel` in favor of `--specialized-decode`**

# 1. Goal

**An author of a specialized decode kernel should write:**

1. A FlyDSL/CuTeDSL implementation and its utilities, in `vllm/models/<model>/<vendor>/`
2. The conditions under which it can run
3. Minimal glue connecting it to the model code

**The author should not have to write:**

1. Another new way to glue the kernel into the model code
3. Basic config checks during start up, re-used by many specialized kernels needs anyway (parallelism, spec decode, graph mode)
4. Checks of whether to run the specizlied kernel or regular vllm code at every step
5. TP rank agreement of the above
6. Updating of CUDA graph capture sizes
7. Kernel selection when one model has more than one specialized kernel
8. Optional: JIT/warm-up registration


This PR implements the latter points.

# 2. How

Declare when the specialized kernel can run:
```python
# refuse causes crash, skip causes fallback to regular vllm execution

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DecodeSpec(Generic[KernelT]):
    name: str
    supports: frozenset[Feature]
    widths: Callable[[VllmConfig], tuple[int, ...]]
    refuse_config: Callable[[VllmConfig], list[str]]
    refuse_model: Callable[[Any], list[str]]
    refuse_caches: Callable[[VllmConfig, KernelT, Mapping[str, Any]], list[str]]
    skip_step: Callable[[VllmConfig, KernelT, int], str | None]
    build: Callable[[VllmConfig, Any, tuple[int, ...]], KernelT]
```

`KernelT` is a stand-in for the entire model forward, implementing

```python
class DecodeImpl(Protocol):
    cache_layers: tuple[str, ...]

    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any: ...
    def bind_caches(self, caches: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None: ...
```

**Optional:** A kernel that compiles its launches from keys (one per width, per layer plan, or whatever the kernel keys on) can additionally implement

```python
@runtime_checkable
class DecodeWarmable(Protocol):
    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]: ...
    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None: ...
```

which will cause the dispatcher to auto-register it for warmup. The existing DSv41 implementation uses this, and so would https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60889, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60731, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60683. The Kimi K3 nvidia kernel jits eagerly since its specialized decode kernel is not created in a region with an active jit registry; hence, this feature is optional.

Once the kernel author has written their CuteDSL/FlyDSL kernel, the two remaining points

> 2. The conditions under which it can run
> 3. Minimal glue connecting it to the model code

is implemented through a Spec and wiring the kernel code through a DecodeImpl. The remainder is taken place by the shared `SpecializedDecode` utility.

_Note: we deliberately put no further constraint on how one implements `run`. There is a big benefit letting each model decide exactly how to structure this. We've already seen many different ways of structuring the underlying flydsl/cutedsl kernels._

## 2.1 Model-side code

The model-side code will look like this:

```python
class MyForCausalLM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config, prefix=""):
        self.decode_spec = select_decode_spec(vllm_config, SPECS)
        self.specialized_decode: SpecializedDecode[MyKernel] | None = None

    def process_weights_after_loading(self):
        # optionally: this code can also be placed in the model state init, but then you cannot benefit from auto-registration of warmup
        if self.decode_spec is not None:
            self.specialized_decode = SpecializedDecode(
                self.model, self.vllm_config, self.decode_spec
            )

    def forward(self, input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors=None, inputs_embeds=None, **kwargs):
        decode = self.specialized_decode
        if decode is not None:
            step = decode.plan(positions, intermediate_tensors)
            if step is not None:
                return decode.run(step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)
        return self.model(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)
```

plus one hook to prepare the kv cache

```python
class MyModelState(DefaultModelState):
    def initialize_kv_cache(self, kv_cache_config, block_tables):
        super().initialize_kv_cache(kv_cache_config, block_tables)
        if self.model.specialized_decode is not None:
            self.model.specialized_decode.bind_caches()
```

On the model side nothing else needs to be touched. 

# 3. How to: adding a second kernel for the same model

Say DSv4.1 gets a gfx942 kernel next to the gfx950 one. Write the FlyDSL kernel, then:

```python
# vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/specialized_decode.py

class DSV41Gfx942Kernel(DSV41Kernel):           # reuse what you want
    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any: ...
        ...
        return self.runner.run_gfx942_kernel(...)

    def compile(self, key):
        width, idx = key
        self.runner.kernels(width, self.plans[idx])


def _refuse_config_gfx942(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
    reasons = []
    if not current_platform.is_gfx942():
        reasons.append("needs a gfx942 GPU")
    ...
    return reasons


DECODE_SPEC_GFX942 = DecodeSpec[DSV41Gfx942Kernel](
    name="dsv41-cdna3",
    supports=frozenset({Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL}),   # no spec decode here
    widths=lambda cfg: tuple(range(1, 17)),            # fewer rows than gfx950
    refuse_config=_refuse_config_gfx942,
    refuse_model=_refuse_model,                        # shared with gfx950
    refuse_caches=_refuse_caches,
    skip_step=_skip_step,
    build=DSV41Gfx942Kernel,
)

SPECS = (DECODE_SPEC_GFX950, DECODE_SPEC_GFX942)
```

Then one line in the model:

```python
self.decode_spec = select_decode_spec(vllm_config, SPECS)
```

The dispatcher takes the first compatible spec. Specializing on something other than arch works the same way. A hyper-specialized batch-size 1 kernel can just set `widths= lambda cfg: (1,)` and be placed first in the `SPECS` list.

# 4. How to: a kernel that only covers part of a layer

A specialized decode kernel might cover only part of a layer, e.g. only o-proj through post-moe AR.

The common dispatcher has no concept of this, and does not need one, because the kernel owns the layer loop. Hence it can decide at every layer whether to run it as a single monokernel, or to run it in the regular vllm model code. 

When we run part of a layer as a specialized kernel, we simply run the regular vllm model code and _inject_ the specialized kernel:

```python
class DSV41Kernel:
    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
        self.model.prologue(input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)
        ....
        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
            layer, plan = model.layers[idx], self.plans.get(...)
            ffn = out = None
            if plan.ffn_only:
                ffn = partial(self.launch_ffn, plan)      # a part of a layer
            else:
                out = self.launch_whole(plan, hidden, positions, ...)
            if out is None:
                out = layer(hidden, positions, ..., decode_ffn=ffn) # run regular vllm and inject
            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix = out
        ...
```

```python
class DeepseekV4DecoderLayer(nn.Module):

    def forward(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        ...
        decode_ffn: Callable | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        ... # run pre etc
        x = self.attn(positions, x, None)
        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
            x = sp_reduce_scatter(x)
        elif not self.attn.wo_b.reduce_results:
            # run the "partial-layer specialized decode kernel"
            if decode_ffn is not None:
                out = decode_ffn(x, residual, post_mix, res_mix, attn_pre)
                if out is not None:
                    return out

```

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The specialized decode conformance kit (RFC #60904): what a model's own
+``DecodeSpec`` must satisfy.
+
+The library's behaviour is tested once, in
+``tests/models/common/specialized_decode/test_specialized_decode.py``. Only what
+a model answers for itself belongs here, so a model pays for it in CI.
+"""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import ForwardContext, override_forward_context
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.dispatch import SpecializedDecode
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.guards import select_decode_spec
+
+KERNEL_BACKENDS = ("aiter", "flydsl")
+"""Backends a spec module must not pull in of its own: it is imported at config
+time, before anything has decided the spec can run. The package holding it is
+the model's own hardware entry point, which already pulls its platform's
+backend, so only what the spec module adds on top of that package counts."""
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def forward(config, mode: CUDAGraphMode, attn_metadata: Any) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """One forward pass's context, as a runner would set it."""
+    context = ForwardContext(
+        no_compile_layers=config.compilation_config.static_forward_context,
+        attn_metadata=attn_metadata,
+        slot_mapping={},
+        cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode,
+    )
+    with override_forward_context(context):
+        yield
+
+
+class DecodeConformance:
+    """What every model's ``DecodeSpec`` must satisfy. Subclass it in the
+    model's test module and fill in the hooks below."""
+
+    specs: tuple[Any, ...]
+    """The model's variants, as it passes them to ``select_decode_spec``."""
+
+    specs_module: str
+    """Where ``specs`` is defined, for the import test to load on its own."""
+
+    def make_config(self, **overrides) -> Any:
+        """A config this spec serves, with ``overrides`` applied on top."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def make_model(self, config) -> Any:
+        """A loaded model this spec serves, with its KV caches bound into
+        ``config.compilation_config.static_forward_context``."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def bad_caches(self, config, model) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Caches that break at least two of ``refuse_caches``'s checks."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @pytest.fixture
+    def config(self):
+        return self.make_config()
+
+    @pytest.fixture
+    def model(self, config):
+        return self.make_model(config)
+
+    @pytest.fixture
+    def decode(self, config, model):
+        return self.make_decode(config, model)
+
+    def make_decode(self, config, model=None, bind: bool = True):
+        """This rank's ``SpecializedDecode``, built the way a model builds it:
+        the variant picked once by ``select_decode_spec``, then the dispatch
+        over the loaded model, then the caches the runner binds."""
+        model = self.make_model(config) if model is None else model
+        spec = select_decode_spec(config, self.specs)
+        assert spec is not None
+        decode = SpecializedDecode(model, config, spec)
+        if bind:
+            decode.bind_caches()
+        return decode
+
+    def test_spec_module_imports_no_kernel_backend(self):
+        module = self.specs_module
+        package = module.rpartition(".")[0]
+        source = (
+            "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import importlib;"
+            f"importlib.import_module({package!r});"
+            "loaded = set(sys.modules);"
+            f"importlib.import_module({module!r});"
+            "print('\\n'.join(set(sys.modules) - loaded))"
+        )
+        loaded = subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "-c", source],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=True,
+        ).stdout.split()
+        pulled = {n.split(".")[0] for n in loaded} & set(KERNEL_BACKENDS)
+        assert not pulled, f"{module} imports {sorted(pulled)}"
+
+    def test_refuse_caches_reports_every_reason(self, config, model, decode):
+        reasons = decode.spec.refuse_caches(
+            decode.vllm_config, decode.kernel, self.bad_caches(config, model)
+        )
+        assert len(reasons) >= 2, reasons
+
+    def test_build_does_not_move_weights(self, config):
+        model = self.make_model(config)
+        before = {n: p.data_ptr() for n, p in model.named_parameters()}
+        self.make_decode(config, model)
+        after = {n: p.data_ptr() for n, p in model.named_parameters()}
+        assert before == after

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The reference kernel: a ``DecodeImpl`` over the layers it replaces."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.spec import DecodeSpec, Step
+
+CACHE_DTYPE = torch.bfloat16
+CACHE_NDIM = 4
+
+
+class ReferenceLayer(torch.nn.Module):
+    """A decoder layer the reference kernel can replace: one weight, one
+    attention layer name, and ``dense`` for the layers a spec skips."""
+
+    def __init__(self, index: int, hidden: int, dense: bool = False):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.index = index
+        self.dense = dense
+        self.attn_name = f"layers.{index}.attn"
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden) * index)
+
+    def forward(self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden: torch.Tensor):
+        return hidden + self.weight
+
+
+class ReferenceModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    """A model shaped like the layer loop a kernel hooks into."""
+
+    def __init__(self, layers: int = 4, hidden: int = 8):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = SimpleNamespace(num_hidden_layers=layers, hidden_size=hidden)
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleList(
+            [ReferenceLayer(i, hidden, dense=i == 0) for i in range(layers)]
+        )
+        self.start_layer = 0
+        self.end_layer = layers
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors=None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden = inputs_embeds
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden = layer(positions, hidden)
+        return hidden
+
+
+class ReferenceKernel:
+    """The model's decode in one launch: the work of every layer it replaces,
+    off views of the model's weights, with the dense layers left to vLLM."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model: ReferenceModel, widths: tuple[int, ...]):
+        self.model = model
+        self.widths = widths
+        served = [
+            model.layers[i]
+            for i in range(model.start_layer, model.end_layer)
+            if not model.layers[i].dense
+        ]
+        self.weights = {layer.index: layer.weight.data for layer in served}
+        self.cache_layers = tuple(layer.attn_name for layer in served)
+        self.launched: list[int] = []
+        self.bound: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        self.compiled: set[Any] = set()
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs):
+        self.launched.append(step.kernel_width)
+        hidden = inputs_embeds
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            weight = self.weights.get(layer.index)
+            if weight is None:
+                hidden = layer(step.positions, hidden)
+            else:
+                hidden = hidden + weight
+        return hidden
+
+    def bind_caches(self, caches) -> None:
+        self.bound = dict(caches)
+
+    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]:
+        return [(i, w) for i in self.weights for w in self.widths]
+
+    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None:
+        self.compiled.add(key)
+
+
+def widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    most = vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
+    return tuple(w for w in (1, 2, 4, 8) if w <= most)
+
+
+def refuse_config(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    if not widths(vllm_config):
+        reasons.append("max_num_seqs below the smallest width")
+    if vllm_config.model_config.dtype is not torch.bfloat16:
+        reasons.append(f"dtype {vllm_config.model_config.dtype}: needs bfloat16")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def refuse_model(model) -> list[str]:
+    return [] if isinstance(model, ReferenceModel) else ["not a ReferenceModel"]
+
+
+def skip_step(vllm_config, kernel: ReferenceKernel, width: int) -> str | None:
+    md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    return "prefill" if md.get("prefill") else None
+
+
+def refuse_caches(vllm_config, kernel: ReferenceKernel, caches) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for name, cache in caches.items():
+        if cache.dtype is not CACHE_DTYPE:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: dtype {cache.dtype}, needs {CACHE_DTYPE}")
+        if cache.ndim != CACHE_NDIM:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: {cache.ndim}d, needs {CACHE_NDIM}d")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def build(vllm_config, model, widths: tuple[int, ...]) -> ReferenceKernel:
+    return ReferenceKernel(vllm_config, model, widths)
+
+
+REFERENCE = DecodeSpec[ReferenceKernel](
+    name="reference",
+    supports=frozenset(),
+    widths=widths,
+    refuse_config=refuse_config,
+    refuse_model=refuse_model,
+    refuse_caches=refuse_caches,
+    skip_step=skip_step,
+    build=build,
+)
+
+REFERENCE_WIDE = replace(
+    REFERENCE,
+    name="reference-wide",
+    refuse_config=lambda c: (
+        refuse_config(c)
+        + (["needs max_num_seqs >= 8"] if c.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs < 8 else [])
+    ),
+)
+
+DECODE_SPECS = (REFERENCE_WIDE, REFERENCE)
+
+
+def make_config(**overrides) -> Any:
+    """A config shaped like the parts of ``VllmConfig`` the library reads.
+
+    Args:
+        **overrides: Top-level attributes to replace. Nested ones are set on
+            the returned object (``config.parallel_config.enable_eplb = True``).
+
+    """
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(specialized_decode=True),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(dtype=torch.bfloat16, enable_sleep_mode=False),
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_seqs=4),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+            data_parallel_size=1,
+            enable_expert_parallel=False,
+            enable_eplb=False,
+            decode_context_parallel_size=1,
+            use_ubatching=False,
+            prefill_context_parallel_size=1,
+        ),
+        offload_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            uva=SimpleNamespace(cpu_offload_gb=0),
+            prefetch=SimpleNamespace(offload_group_size=0),
+        ),
+        aux_output_config=SimpleNamespace(enable_return_routed_experts=False),
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL,
+            cudagraph_capture_sizes=[1, 2, 3, 4, 16],
+            static_forward_context={},
+        ),
+        lora_config=None,
+        kv_transfer_config=None,
+        speculative_config=None,
+        weight_transfer_config=None,
+        use_v2_model_runner=True,
+    )
+    for key, value in overrides.items():
+        setattr(config, key, value)
+    return config
+
+
+def make_model(config, layers: int = 4) -> ReferenceModel:
+    """A loaded reference model, with its KV caches already in the config's
+    static forward context."""
+    model = ReferenceModel(layers=layers)
+    set_caches(config, model)
+    return model
+
+
+def set_caches(config, model, **kwargs) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Puts one cache a layer in the static forward context, and returns them."""
+    caches = {
+        layer.attn_name: make_cache(**kwargs)
+        for layer in model.layers
+        if not layer.dense
+    }
+    config.compilation_config.static_forward_context = {
+        name: SimpleNamespace(kv_cache=cache) for name, cache in caches.items()
+    }
+    return caches
+
+
+def make_cache(dtype=torch.bfloat16, ndim: int = 4) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.zeros((2,) + (1,) * (ndim - 1), dtype=dtype)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The specialized decode library against the reference spec: which variant a
+config gets, what the build and the cache binding hand the kernel, and which
+steps reach it."""
+
+import importlib
+import sys
+from dataclasses import replace
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.models.common.specialized_decode import reference
+from tests.models.common.specialized_decode.kit import forward
+from vllm.compilation.wrapper import TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import JitWarmupRegistry
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.dispatch import SpecializedDecode
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.guards import (
+    _features_in_use,
+    _refuse_config,
+    _select_spec,
+    select_decode_spec,
+)
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.spec import (
+    DecodeUnsupported,
+    Feature,
+    Step,
+)
+
+SPECS = reference.DECODE_SPECS
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def config():
+    return reference.make_config()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def model(config):
+    return reference.make_model(config)
+
+
+def make_decode(config, model, bind: bool = True):
+    """This rank's dispatch, built the way a model builds it."""
+    spec = select_decode_spec(config, SPECS)
+    assert spec is not None
+    decode = SpecializedDecode(model, config, spec)
+    if bind:
+        decode.bind_caches()
+    return decode
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def decode(config, model):
+    return make_decode(config, model)
+
+
+def positions(width: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.zeros(width, dtype=torch.long)
+
+
+# Selection
+
+
+def test_off_without_the_flag(config):
+    config.kernel_config.specialized_decode = False
+    sizes = list(config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes)
+    assert select_decode_spec(config, SPECS) is None
+    assert config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes == sizes
+
+
+def test_the_first_servable_variant_wins(config):
+    config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs = 4
+    spec, refusals = _select_spec(SPECS, config)
+    assert spec is reference.REFERENCE
+    assert refusals == {"reference-wide": ["needs max_num_seqs >= 8"]}
+
+    config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs = 8
+    spec, refusals = _select_spec(SPECS, config)
+    assert spec is reference.REFERENCE_WIDE
+    assert refusals == {}
+
+
+def test_every_variant_refused_names_every_variant(config):
+    config.model_config.dtype = torch.float16
+    with pytest.raises(DecodeUnsupported) as excinfo:
+        select_decode_spec(config, SPECS)
+    message = str(excinfo.value)
+    for spec in SPECS:
+        assert spec.name in message
+    assert message.count("needs bfloat16") == len(SPECS)
+
+
+def test_refusals_report_every_reason(config):
+    config.parallel_config.enable_eplb = True
+    config.use_v2_model_runner = False
+    config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode = CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
+    config.model_config.dtype = torch.float16
+    assert _refuse_config(reference.REFERENCE, config) == [
+        "eplb is not supported",
+        "needs Model Runner V2",
+        "CUDA graph mode PIECEWISE: decode needs FULL graphs",
+        f"dtype {torch.float16}: needs bfloat16",
+    ]
+
+
+IN_USE = [
+    (
+        Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "pipeline_parallel_size", 2),
+    ),
+    (
+        Feature.DATA_PARALLEL,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "data_parallel_size", 2),
+    ),
+    (
+        Feature.EXPERT_PARALLEL,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "enable_expert_parallel", True),
+    ),
+    (Feature.EPLB, lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "enable_eplb", True)),
+    (
+        Feature.DECODE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "decode_context_parallel_size", 2),
+    ),
+    (Feature.UBATCHING, lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "use_ubatching", True)),
+    (
+        Feature.PREFILL_CONTEXT_PARALLEL,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.parallel_config, "prefill_context_parallel_size", 2),
+    ),
+    (Feature.LORA, lambda c: setattr(c, "lora_config", object())),
+    (Feature.KV_CONNECTOR, lambda c: setattr(c, "kv_transfer_config", object())),
+    (
+        Feature.ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.aux_output_config, "enable_return_routed_experts", True),
+    ),
+    (
+        Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING,
+        lambda c: setattr(c, "speculative_config", object()),
+    ),
+    (Feature.SLEEP_MODE, lambda c: setattr(c.model_config, "enable_sleep_mode", True)),
+    (
+        Feature.CPU_WEIGHT_OFFLOAD,
+        lambda c: setattr(c.offload_config.uva, "cpu_offload_gb", 1),
+    ),
+    (Feature.WEIGHT_UPDATES, lambda c: setattr(c, "weight_transfer_config", object())),
+]
+
+
+def test_every_feature_can_be_turned_on():
+    assert {feature for feature, _ in IN_USE} == set(Feature)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "feature, turn_on", IN_USE, ids=[feature.value for feature, _ in IN_USE]
+)
+def test_a_feature_the_spec_does_not_list_refuses(config, feature, turn_on):
+    turn_on(config)
+    assert _features_in_use(config) == {feature}
+    assert _refuse_config(reference.REFERENCE, config) == [
+        f"{feature.value} is not supported"
+    ]
+    serving = replace(reference.REFERENCE, supports=frozenset({feature}))
+    assert _refuse_config(serving, config) == []
+
+
+def test_the_reference_config_reads_like_a_real_one():
+    """The fake config the tests pass has every field ``_features_in_use``
+    reads off a real ``VllmConfig``, so a new feature cannot drift past it."""
+    real = VllmConfig()
+    real.model_config = SimpleNamespace(enable_sleep_mode=False)
+    assert _features_in_use(real) == _features_in_use(reference.make_config()) == set()
+
+
+def test_capture_sizes_become_the_widths(config):
+    config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes = [1, 3, 4, 16, 32]
+    assert select_decode_spec(config, SPECS) is reference.REFERENCE
+    assert config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes == [1, 2, 4, 16, 32]
+
+
+def test_a_spec_can_keep_the_engines_capture_sizes(config):
+    """A spec that pads serves whatever sizes the deployment captures, so it
+    opts out of having them rewritten."""
+    spec = replace(reference.REFERENCE, set_capture_sizes=False)
+    config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes = [1, 3, 4, 16, 32]
+
+    assert select_decode_spec(config, spec) is spec
+
+    assert config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes == [1, 3, 4, 16, 32]
+
+
+# Build
+
+
+def test_build_takes_the_loaded_model_and_every_width(config, model, decode):
+    assert decode.widths == reference.widths(config)
+    assert decode.kernel.model is model
+    assert decode.kernel.widths == decode.widths
+
+
+def test_the_loaded_model_can_refuse(config):
+    spec = select_decode_spec(config, SPECS)
+    with pytest.raises(DecodeUnsupported, match="not a ReferenceModel"):
+        SpecializedDecode(torch.nn.Linear(2, 2), config, spec)
+
+
+def test_a_torch_compiled_model_is_refused(config):
+    spec = select_decode_spec(config, SPECS)
+    compiled = object.__new__(TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper)
+    with pytest.raises(DecodeUnsupported, match="support_torch_compile"):
+        SpecializedDecode(compiled, config, spec)
+
+
+def test_warmup_compiles_every_key_the_kernel_declares(config, model):
+    registry = JitWarmupRegistry(config)
+    with registry.activate():
+        decode = make_decode(config, model, bind=False)
+    assert len(registry) == 1
+    registry.warmup()
+    assert decode.kernel.compiled == set(decode.kernel.warmup_keys())
+
+
+def test_a_kernel_without_keys_registers_no_warmup(config, model):
+    spec = replace(
+        select_decode_spec(config, SPECS),
+        build=lambda c, m, w: SimpleNamespace(
+            cache_layers=(), warmup_keys=lambda: [], bind_caches=lambda caches: None
+        ),
+    )
+    registry = JitWarmupRegistry(config)
+    with registry.activate():
+        SpecializedDecode(model, config, spec)
+    assert len(registry) == 0
+
+
+# Cache binding
+
+
+def test_binding_hands_the_kernel_its_cache_layers(config, model, decode):
+    assert set(decode.kernel.bound) == set(decode.kernel.cache_layers)
+
+    rebound = reference.set_caches(config, model)

+def _weights_stub(**fields) -> Any:

+def _bytes(*shape) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.zeros(*shape, dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _proj(out=HIDDEN, inp=HIDDEN) -> Any:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        weight=torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out, inp)),
+        weight_scale=_bytes(out, 4),
+        reduce_results=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _norm() -> Any:
+    return SimpleNamespace(weight=torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(HIDDEN)))
+
+
+def _moe(**overrides) -> Any:
+    experts = SimpleNamespace(
+        w13_weight=_bytes(4, HIDDEN),
+        w13_weight_scale=_bytes(4, 4),
+        w2_weight=_bytes(4, HIDDEN),
+        w2_weight_scale=_bytes(4, 4),
+        quant_method=SimpleNamespace(mxfp4_backend=Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16),
+    )
+    fields = dict(
+        experts=SimpleNamespace(routed_experts=experts),
+        shared_experts=SimpleNamespace(gate_up_proj=_proj(), down_proj=_proj()),
+        gate=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=_proj().weight, e_score_correction_bias=None, tid2eid=None
+        ),
+        n_routed_experts=384,
+        n_activated_experts=6,
+        routed_scaling_factor=1.5,
+        swiglu_limit=10.0,
+        scoring_func="sqrtsoftplus",

+    return SimpleNamespace(**(fields | overrides))

+
+def _attn(index: int, **overrides) -> Any:
+    fields = dict(
+        layer_id=index,
+        compressor=None,
+        indexer=None,
+        compress_ratio=1,
+        kv_mxfp8=False,
+        kv_cache_dtype="fp8_ds_mla",
+        swa_cache_layer=SimpleNamespace(prefix=f"layers.{index}.swa", kv_cache=None),
+        compressed_cache_prefix=f"layers.{index}.comp",
+        topk_indices_buffer=torch.zeros(64, 8, dtype=torch.int32),
+        fused_wqa_wkv=_proj(),
+        q_norm=_norm(),
+        kv_norm=_norm(),
+        wq_b=_proj(),
+        wo_a=_proj(),
+        wo_b=_proj(),
+        attn_sink=None,
+        rotary_emb=SimpleNamespace(cos_sin_cache=torch.zeros(8, 8)),
+        _compressed_kv_cache=lambda: make_cache(),
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(**(fields | overrides))
+
+
+class _Layer(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, index: int, **overrides):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.attn = _attn(index, **overrides.pop("attn", {}))
+        self.ffn = _moe(**overrides.pop("ffn", {}))
+        self.engram = None
+        self.use_sequence_parallel = False
+        self.fuse_seam_norm = True
+        self.hc_mult = 4
+        self.hc_attn_fn = self.hc_ffn_fn = None
+        self.hc_attn_scale = self.hc_ffn_scale = 1.0
+        self.hc_attn_base = self.hc_ffn_base = 0.0
+        self.attn_norm = _norm()
+        self.ffn_norm = _norm()
+        self.mhc_post = lambda x, residual, post, res: residual
+        for key, value in overrides.items():
+            setattr(self, key, value)
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(HIDDEN))
+        self.taken: list = []
+
+    def forward(self, x, positions, input_ids, *rest, decode_ffn=None):
+        self.taken.append(("layer", self.attn.layer_id, decode_ffn is not None))
+        return _stream()
+
+
+def _stream() -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+    """What a decoder layer returns: the stream and its three mixes."""
+    return (
+        torch.zeros(1, HIDDEN),
+        torch.zeros(1, 4, HIDDEN),
+        torch.zeros(1, 4, 1),
+        torch.zeros(1, 4, 4),
+        torch.zeros(1, 4),
+    )
+

+class _Model(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config):

+        self.config = config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.vllm_config = config
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleList(_Layer(i) for i in range(LAYERS))
+        self.start_layer = 0
+        self.end_layer = LAYERS
+        self.decoder_replay_layers = None
+
+    def prologue(self, input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, embeds, lookback):
+        return embeds, input_ids, None, None, None, positions.shape[0]
+
+    def after_layer(
+        self, idx, hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, tokens, aux, replay=True
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    def epilogue(self, hidden, *rest, replay=True):
+        return hidden

+def make_cache(blocks: int = 4, block: int = 32) -> torch.Tensor:

+def _swa(**overrides) -> Any:

+def _metadata(model, **overrides) -> dict:

+def _rocm_platform() -> ModuleType:

+    if "vllm.platforms.rocm" not in sys.modules:
+        probe = torch.cuda.get_device_properties
+        torch.cuda.get_device_properties = lambda *_, **__: SimpleNamespace(
+            gcnArchName="gfx950"
+        )
+        try:
+            importlib.import_module("vllm.platforms.rocm")
+        finally:
+            torch.cuda.get_device_properties = probe
+    return sys.modules["vllm.platforms.rocm"]

+def test_first_layer_takes_the_embedding(monkeypatch):
+    """Layer 0's residual is the embedding broadcast to the four streams, which
+    K1 takes as it is (no owed post to fold)."""
+    decode, model = _build(monkeypatch)
+    positions = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long)
+    with forward(decode.vllm_config, CUDAGraphMode.FULL, _metadata(model)):
+        out = decode.kernel.launch_whole(
+            _plan(decode, 0), torch.zeros(1, HIDDEN), positions, None, None, None, None
+        )
+    assert out[0] == "whole" and not out[2]["fold"]
+    assert out[1][2].shape == (1, 4, HIDDEN)
+
+
+def test_ffn_launch_takes_wo_b_unreduced(monkeypatch):
+    decode, model = _build(monkeypatch, compressor=object())
+    with forward(decode.vllm_config, CUDAGraphMode.FULL, _metadata(model)):
+        plan = _plan(decode, 1)
+        assert plan.ffn_only
+        out = decode.kernel.launch_ffn(
+            plan,
+            torch.zeros(1, HIDDEN),
+            torch.zeros(1, 4, HIDDEN),
+            torch.zeros(1, 4, 1),
+            torch.zeros(1, 4, 4),
+            torch.zeros(1, 4),
+        )
+    assert out[0] == "ffn"
+
+
+def test_run_takes_every_layer_the_way_its_launch_allows(monkeypatch):
+    """One loop over the backbone, from the model's prologue to its epilogue:
+    a whole-layer launch replaces the layer, a declined one and a layer without
+    a launch fall through to it, and an FFN-only launch rides into it."""
+    config = make_config()
+    model = TestDsv41Spec().make_model(config)
+    model.layers[2].attn.compressor = object()
+    model.layers[4].use_sequence_parallel = True
+    decode, _ = _build(monkeypatch, config=config, model=model)
+
+    def launch_whole(plan, *args, **kwargs):
+        layer_id = plan.layer.attn.layer_id
+        model.layers[layer_id].taken.append(("launch", layer_id))
+        return None if layer_id == 1 else _stream()
+
+    decode.kernel.launch_whole = launch_whole
+
+    step = Step(width=1, kernel_width=1, positions=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long))
+    out = decode.kernel.run(step, None, torch.zeros(1, HIDDEN))

+        [("launch", 0)],
+        [("launch", 1), ("layer", 1, False)],
+        [("layer", 2, True)],
+        [("launch", 3)],
+        [("layer", 4, False)],
+        [("launch", 5)],
+    ]
+
+
+DRAFT_LAYERS = 2
+DRAFT_EXPERTS = 128
+DRAFT_TOPK = 3
+DRAFT_TOKENS = 5
+
+
+class _DraftModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    """The DSpark draft head's backbone: its own layers, routing and stream."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.vllm_config = config
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleList(
+            _Layer(
+                LAYERS + i,
+                attn=dict(compress_ratio=0),
+                ffn=dict(
+                    n_routed_experts=DRAFT_EXPERTS, n_activated_experts=DRAFT_TOPK
+                ),
+            )
+            for i in range(DRAFT_LAYERS)
+        )
+        self.hc_mult = 4
+
+    def prologue(self, input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds):
+        return inputs_embeds, input_ids, positions.shape[0]
+
+    def epilogue(self, hidden, *rest):
+        return hidden
+
+
+def make_draft_config(**overrides) -> Any:
+    config = make_config(**overrides)
+    config.speculative_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_speculative_tokens=DRAFT_TOKENS, method="dspark"
+    )
+    hf = config.model_config.hf_config
+    hf.sliding_window = sd.SWA_WIDTH
+    hf.dspark_n_routed_experts = DRAFT_EXPERTS
+    hf.dspark_num_experts_per_tok = DRAFT_TOPK
+    return config
+
+
+def _build_draft(monkeypatch, config=None, model=None):
+    _gpu(monkeypatch)
+    config = config or make_draft_config()
+    model = model if model is not None else _DraftModel(config)
+    sfc = config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+    for layer in model.layers:
+        layer.attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache = make_cache()
+        sfc[layer.attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix] = layer.attn.swa_cache_layer
+    spec = select_decode_spec(config, sd.DRAFT_DECODE_SPEC)
+    return SpecializedDecode(model, config, spec), model
+
+
+def _draft_metadata(model, **overrides) -> dict:
+    width = sd.draft_swa_width(model.vllm_config)
+    fields = dict(
+        decode_swa_width=width,
+        decode_swa_indices=torch.zeros(8, 1, width, dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+    return {
+        layer.attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix: _swa(**(fields | overrides))
+        for layer in model.layers
+    }
+
+
+def test_draft_rows_span_the_window_and_the_drafts():
+    """The draft's SWA rows are a block's non-causal window, the causal window
+    plus the drafts, padded; not a decode token's."""
+    config = make_draft_config()
+    width = sd.draft_swa_width(config)
+    assert width >= sd.SWA_WIDTH + DRAFT_TOKENS
+    assert width != sd.SWA_WIDTH
+
+
+def test_draft_layers_take_the_drafts_own_routing_and_rows(monkeypatch):
+    """Every draft layer takes a launch, from a runner built for the draft's
+    128 experts, top-3 and non-causal rows, not the backbone's."""
+    decode, model = _build_draft(monkeypatch)
+    kernel = decode.kernel
+    assert set(kernel.plans) == {layer.attn.layer_id for layer in model.layers}
+    assert kernel.runner.routing == dict(
+        experts=DRAFT_EXPERTS,
+        topk=DRAFT_TOPK,
+        ug_groups=sd.DRAFT_UG_GROUPS,
+        swa_width=sd.draft_swa_width(model.vllm_config),
+    )
+    # The draft reads no compressed keys, so it binds only its SWA caches.
+    assert kernel.cache_layers == tuple(
+        sorted(layer.attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix for layer in model.layers)
+    )
+    decode.bind_caches()
+
+
+def test_draft_layer_with_compressed_keys_keeps_vllm_path(monkeypatch):
+    """The draft has no FFN-only launch: a layer the kernels cannot take whole
+    runs as vLLM's."""
+    config = make_draft_config()
+    model = _DraftModel(config)
+    for layer in model.layers:
+        layer.attn.compressor = object()
+    decode, _ = _build_draft(monkeypatch, config=config, model=model)
+    assert not decode.kernel.plans
+
+
+def test_draft_first_layer_takes_the_broadcast_embedding(monkeypatch):
+    """The draft's first layer is handed the embedding already broadcast to the
+    hc copies, so the launch takes it as the residual and the first copy as the
+    stream."""
+    decode, model = _build_draft(monkeypatch)
+    positions = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long)
+    embeds = torch.zeros(1, 4, HIDDEN)
+    with forward(decode.vllm_config, CUDAGraphMode.FULL, _draft_metadata(model)):
+        out = decode.kernel.launch_whole(
+            _plan(decode, LAYERS), embeds, positions, None, None, None, None
+        )
+    assert out[0] == "whole" and not out[2]["fold"]
+    assert out[1][1].shape == (1, HIDDEN)
+    assert out[1][2].shape == (1, 4, HIDDEN)
+
+
+def test_draft_and_target_take_only_their_own_rows(monkeypatch):
+    """Each refuses the other's SWA width, so a draft step cannot run on the
+    backbone's kernels or the other way round."""
+    draft, draft_model = _build_draft(monkeypatch)
+    target, target_model = _build(monkeypatch)
+
+    def skip(decode, metadata):
+        with forward(decode.vllm_config, CUDAGraphMode.FULL, metadata):
+            return decode.spec.skip_step(decode.vllm_config, decode.kernel, 1)
+
+    assert skip(draft, _draft_metadata(draft_model)) is None
+    assert skip(target, _metadata(target_model)) is None
+    assert "SWA width" in skip(
+        draft, _draft_metadata(draft_model, decode_swa_width=sd.SWA_WIDTH)
+    )
+    assert "SWA width" in skip(
+        target,
+        _metadata(
+            target_model, decode_swa_width=sd.draft_swa_width(draft_model.vllm_config)
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def test_draft_run_takes_every_layer_the_way_its_launch_allows(monkeypatch):
+    decode, model = _build_draft(monkeypatch)
+
+    def launch_whole(plan, *args, **kwargs):
+        layer_id = plan.layer.attn.layer_id
+        model.layers[layer_id - LAYERS].taken.append(("launch", layer_id))
+        return None if layer_id == LAYERS else _stream()
+
+    decode.kernel.launch_whole = launch_whole
+
+    step = Step(width=1, kernel_width=1, positions=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long))
+    out = decode.kernel.run(step, None, torch.zeros(1, 4, HIDDEN))
+
+    assert out.shape == (1, HIDDEN)
+    assert [layer.taken for layer in model.layers] == [
+        [("launch", LAYERS), ("layer", LAYERS, False)],
+        [("launch", LAYERS + 1)],
+    ]
+
+
+def test_launch_declines_a_layout_it_cannot_read(monkeypatch):
+    """A later pipeline stage's first layer gets a stream without the mixes:

+            torch.zeros(1, 4, HIDDEN),
+            positions,
+            None,
+            None,
+            None,
+            None,
+        )
+    assert out is None

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Dispatcher for specialized decoder kernels.
+
+Performs validation, jit registration, planning, and dispatching of specialized decode
+kernels for a model based on a given specification.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Generic
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import VllmJitKernel
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.guards import (
+    _refuse_model,
+    tp_agree,
+    tp_group,
+)
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.spec import (
+    DecodeSpec,
+    DecodeUnsupported,
+    DecodeWarmable,
+    KernelT,
+    Step,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+class DecodeWarmup(VllmJitKernel["DecodeWarmup.CompileKey"]):
+    """A spec's kernel builds as vLLM JIT warm-up keys."""
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class CompileKey:
+        spec: str
+        build: Any
+
+    def __init__(self, spec: str, kernel: DecodeWarmable):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.spec = spec
+        self.kernel = kernel
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(self) -> list["DecodeWarmup.CompileKey"]:
+        return [self.CompileKey(self.spec, b) for b in self.kernel.warmup_keys()]
+
+    def compile(self, compile_key: "DecodeWarmup.CompileKey") -> None:
+        self.kernel.compile(compile_key.build)
+        self._compiled_cache[compile_key] = True
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode(Generic[KernelT]):
+    """A model's specialized decode on this rank.
+
+    It reads the spec and builds the kernel, registers it for warm-up if it
+    compiles from keys, checks the caches whenever the runner binds them, and
+    decides each step
+    between the kernel and vLLM's own forward. The kernel it builds is held in
+    the ``kernel`` attribute.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, model, vllm_config: "VllmConfig", spec: DecodeSpec[KernelT]):
+        """Builds this rank's kernel.
+
+        Args:
+            model: The loaded model, in ``process_weights_after_loading``.
+            vllm_config: The engine's config.
+            spec: The spec to build and run.
+
+        """
+        self.spec = spec
+        reasons = _refuse_model(spec, model)
+        agreed = tp_agree(not reasons, tp_group()[2])
+        refused = f"Specialized decode {spec.name} refused for the loaded model"
+        if reasons:
+            raise DecodeUnsupported(f"{refused}: " + "; ".join(reasons))
+        if not agreed:
+            raise DecodeUnsupported(f"{refused}: another TP rank refused")
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self.widths = tuple(sorted(spec.widths(vllm_config)))
+        self._bound = False
+        self.kernel: KernelT = spec.build(vllm_config, model, self.widths)
+        kernel = self.kernel
+        if isinstance(kernel, DecodeWarmable) and kernel.warmup_keys():
+            DecodeWarmup(spec.name, kernel).register_warmup()
+        logger.info("Specialized decode %s: widths %s", spec.name, list(self.widths))
+
+    def bind_caches(self) -> None:
+        """Validate and bind caches to the kernel.
+
+        The underlying kernel only ever sees caches this spec has accepted.
+        """
+        sfc = self.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        caches = {n: sfc[n].kv_cache for n in self.kernel.cache_layers}
+        reasons = self.spec.refuse_caches(self.vllm_config, self.kernel, caches)
+        if reasons:
+            raise DecodeUnsupported(
+                f"Specialized decode {self.spec.name} caches: " + "; ".join(reasons)
+            )
+        self.kernel.bind_caches(caches)
+        self._bound = True
+
+    def _kernel_width(self, width: int) -> int | None:
+        """The width the kernel launches at for a step of ``width`` rows, or
+        None when the spec serves no width for it."""
+        if self.spec.pad_steps:
+            return next((w for w in self.widths if w >= width), None)
+        return width if width in self.widths else None
+
+    def plan(self, positions: torch.Tensor, intermediate_tensors=None) -> Step | None:
+        """This step's plan, or None to run the model's own forward instead.
+
+        A step can fall back to running the model's own forward when the kernel cannot
+        serve it, as described by the spec.
+        """
+        width = positions.size(-1)
+        kernel_width = self._kernel_width(width)
+        why: str | None
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None:
+            why = "pipeline stage input"
+        elif kernel_width is None:
+            why = "width"
+        elif not is_forward_context_available():
+            why = "no forward context"
+        elif get_forward_context().cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
+            why = "piecewise"
+        elif not self._bound:
+            why = "caches not bound"
+        else:
+            why = self.spec.skip_step(self.vllm_config, self.kernel, kernel_width)
+        if why is not None:
+            logger.info_once(
+                "Specialized decode %s: step on vLLM's path (%s)", self.spec.name, why
+            )
+            return None
+        assert kernel_width is not None
+        return Step(width=width, kernel_width=kernel_width, positions=positions)
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
+        """Run the specialized kernel, returning what the model's own forward would
+        have returned."""
+        return self.kernel.run(step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Common validation logic for specialized decode kernels."""
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.spec import (
+    DecodeSpec,
+    DecodeUnsupported,
+    Feature,
+    KernelT,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_FULL_MODES = (
+    CUDAGraphMode.NONE,
+    CUDAGraphMode.FULL,
+    CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY,
+    CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,
+)
+
+
+def tp_group() -> tuple[int, int, object | None]:
+    """This rank's (rank, world size, CPU group) in the TP group, and
+    (0, 1, None) before distributed is initialized."""
+    if not dist.is_available() or not dist.is_initialized():
+        return 0, 1, None
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+    tp = get_tp_group()
+    return tp.rank_in_group, tp.world_size, tp.cpu_group
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """Agree on a boolean across the TP group.
+
+    Args:
+        ok: This rank's local verdict.
+        group: The TP group's CPU (gloo) process group, or None for one rank.
+
+    """
+    if group is None:
+        return ok
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def _enabled(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> bool:
+    """Whether the engine is configured to run specialized decode."""
+    return bool(vllm_config.kernel_config.specialized_decode)
+
+
+def _features_in_use(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> set[Feature]:
+    """Features in use by this config."""
+    pc = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    oc = vllm_config.offload_config
+    on = {
+        Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL: pc.pipeline_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.DATA_PARALLEL: pc.data_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.EXPERT_PARALLEL: pc.enable_expert_parallel,
+        Feature.EPLB: pc.enable_eplb,
+        Feature.DECODE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL: pc.decode_context_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.UBATCHING: pc.use_ubatching,
+        Feature.PREFILL_CONTEXT_PARALLEL: pc.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.LORA: vllm_config.lora_config is not None,
+        Feature.KV_CONNECTOR: vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None,
+        Feature.ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE: (
+            vllm_config.aux_output_config.enable_return_routed_experts
+        ),
+        Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING: vllm_config.speculative_config is not None,
+        Feature.SLEEP_MODE: vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode,
+        Feature.CPU_WEIGHT_OFFLOAD: (
+            oc.uva.cpu_offload_gb > 0 or oc.prefetch.offload_group_size > 0
+        ),
+        Feature.WEIGHT_UPDATES: vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None,
+    }
+    return {f for f, used in on.items() if used}
+
+
+def _refuse_config(spec: DecodeSpec[Any], vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> list[str]:
+    """The reasons the config cannot run the specialized decode kernel, if any."""
+    reasons = [
+        f"{f.value} is not supported"
+        for f in sorted(_features_in_use(vllm_config) - spec.supports)
+    ]
+    if not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner:
+        reasons.append("needs Model Runner V2")
+    mode = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+    if mode is not None and mode not in _FULL_MODES:
+        reasons.append(f"CUDA graph mode {mode.name}: decode needs FULL graphs")
+    return reasons + list(spec.refuse_config(vllm_config))
+
+
+def _refuse_model(spec: DecodeSpec[Any], model) -> list[str]:
+    """The reasons the mode cannot run the specialized decode kernel, if any."""
+    from vllm.compilation.wrapper import TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper
+
+    reasons = []
+    if isinstance(model, TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper):
+        reasons.append(
+            "model is torch.compile'd: specialized decode replaces the layer loop, "
+            "so the model must not carry @support_torch_compile"
+        )
+    return reasons + list(spec.refuse_model(model))
+
+
+def _select_spec(
+    specs: Sequence[DecodeSpec[Any]], vllm_config: "VllmConfig"
+) -> tuple[DecodeSpec[Any] | None, dict[str, list[str]]]:
+    """Get the first compatible spec."""
+    refusals: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for spec in specs:
+        reasons = _refuse_config(spec, vllm_config)
+        if not reasons:
+            return spec, refusals
+        refusals[spec.name] = reasons
+    return None, refusals
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""DeepSeek-V4.1's model runner state on ROCm: the shared state plus the
+specialized decode's cache checks."""

+    draft's, for every cache the runner binds: the throwaway one memory
+    profiling allocates, then the real one."""

-"""DeepSeek-V4.1 mono decode layer on ROCm CDNA4 (``--monokernel``).

-A decode step's backbone layer -- the attention seam, the attention, its TP
-all-reduce, the FFN seam, the MoE and its all-reduce -- runs as two persistent
-FlyDSL launches (``mono``, this directory) on the layer's loaded
-weights, the TP reductions inside the kernels. Every backbone layer of the
-checkpoint runs whole (compress ratio 0, 1 or 2 over ``fp8_ds_mla`` records):
-the first layer and the Engram layers hand K1 a settled residual, and an index
-source runs vLLM's compressor and indexer between the two launches. A layer
-outside that (an MXFP8 KV cache, another indexer) keeps vLLM's attention seam
-and attention and runs the rest as one launch, the FFN launch, from wo_b's
-unreduced output. A step takes the kernels when it is decode only, at most
-``MAX_ROWS`` rows (eager or a FULL CUDA graph: the model is not torch.compiled);
-a whole layer also needs its SWA rows as the kernels read them (causal windows;
-for the DSpark draft's layers, the block's non-causal rows). Anything else runs
-the layer as before; the paths share every tensor at the layer boundary, so they
-interleave freely.

-other's pushes): the conditions read only metadata every rank holds alike.
