+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1's decode kernels: one launch a layer over the stock backbone,
+and the same over the DSpark draft head's layers."""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import partial
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.spec import Step
+
+from ..spec import (
+    DRAFT_UG_GROUPS,
+    EXPERTS,
+    MAX_ROWS,
+    RECORD,
+    SWA_WIDTH,
+    TOPK,
+    draft_routing,
+    draft_swa_width,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _record_view(kv: torch.Tensor, block: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A layer's fp8_ds_mla cache as [blocks, block, RECORD] bytes (a block's
+    data rows, then its scale words: the kernels index both from it)."""
+    kv = kv if kv.dtype == torch.uint8 else kv.view(torch.uint8)
+    return torch.as_strided(kv, (kv.shape[0], block, RECORD), (kv.stride(0), RECORD, 1))
+
+
+def _scale_bytes(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return scale if scale.dtype == torch.uint8 else scale.view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _select(
+    layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer",
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    normed: torch.Tensor,
+    qr: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """An index source's compressor and top-k selection, from K1's normed input
+    and bf16 qr: ``_forward_csa2_full`` / ``_forward_csa2_reindex`` and the
+    indexer op, serial."""
+    attn = layer.attn
+    comp, indexer = attn.compressor, attn.indexer
+    assert indexer is not None
+    if comp is not None:
+        kv_score = torch.mm(
+            normed, comp.fused_wkv_wgate.weight.T, out_dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        latent = comp(kv_score, positions)
+        comp.insert_cache(latent, positions, attn.rotary_emb)
+        indexer._produce_k(latent, positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb)
+    weights, _ = indexer.weights_proj(normed)
+    q, q_scale, weights = indexer.forward_q(
+        qr, None, weights, positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb
+    )
+    assert weights is not None
+    indexer.indexer_op(
+        normed, (q, q_scale) if q_scale is not None else q, None, weights
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LayerPlan:
+    """One decoder layer's launch, settled at load.
+
+    An ``ffn_only`` layer keeps vLLM's attention and its launch takes wo_b's
+    unreduced output, so its weights are all it has; the rest is what a
+    whole-layer launch reads off the layer.
+    """
+
+    layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer"
+    weights: Any
+    ffn_only: bool
+    ratio: int = 0
+    index: bool = False
+    swa_key: str | None = None
+    comp_key: str | None = None
+    folds: tuple[bool, ...] = ()
+
+
+class LayerLaunches:
+    """The launches of one stack of DSv4.1 decoder layers: the backbone's, or
+    the DSpark draft's, which has its own routing, SWA rows and runner.
+
+    A subclass owns the layer loop in ``run``; everything the launches need is
+    settled here, at load.
+    """
+
+    draft = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config,
+        model,
+        widths: tuple[int, ...],
+        experts: int,
+        topk: int,
+        ug_groups: int,
+        swa_width: int,
+    ):
+        from vllm.models.common.specialized_decode.guards import tp_group
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.specialized_decode.mono.runner import (
+            MAX_TOKENS,
+            DSV41MonoLayer,
+        )
+
+        assert MAX_TOKENS >= MAX_ROWS, MAX_TOKENS
+        rank, world, cpu_group = tp_group()
+        device = next(model.parameters()).device
+        self.model = model
+        self.experts, self.topk, self.swa_width = experts, topk, swa_width
+        self.runner = DSV41MonoLayer(
+            world,
+            rank,
+            cpu_group,
+            device,
+            experts=experts,
+            topk=topk,
+            ug_groups=ug_groups,
+            swa_width=swa_width,
+        )
+        self.embed_layer = getattr(model, "start_layer", 0)
+        # A decode step is never trimmed, so ``run`` owns every layer, the ones
+        # past the replay cut included.
+        self.layer_end = getattr(model, "end_layer", len(model.layers))
+        self.widths = widths
+        self.swa_keys: list[str] = []
+        self.comp_keys: list[str] = []
+        self.plans: dict[int, LayerPlan] = {}
+
+        tp_size = vllm_config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
+        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
+            layer = model.layers[idx]
+            plan = self._plan_layer(layer, tp_size, first=idx == self.embed_layer)

+                continue
+            self.plans[layer.attn.layer_id] = plan
+            if plan.ffn_only:
+                continue

+                (plan.swa_key, self.swa_keys),
+                (plan.comp_key, self.comp_keys),
+            ):
+                if key is not None and key not in keys:
+                    keys.append(key)

+
+    def _plan_layer(self, layer, tp_size: int, first: bool) -> LayerPlan | None:
+        """Info needed to run the specialized decode kernel for this layer."""
+        attn = layer.attn
+        why = _skip_layer(layer, self.experts, self.topk)
+        if why is not None:
+            logger.info_once(
+                "DSv4.1 specialized decode: layer %d on vLLM's path (%s)",
+                attn.layer_id,
+                why,
+            )
+            return None
+        why = _ffn_only(layer)
+        if why is None and self.draft and (attn.compress_ratio or attn.indexer):
+            why = "compressed keys"
+        if why is not None and self.draft:
+            # The draft has no FFN launch: its layers run whole or not at all.
+            logger.info_once(
+                "DSv4.1 specialized decode: the draft layers on vLLM's path (%s)", why
+            )

+        weights = _weights(layer, why is not None, tp_size, self.experts)
+        if why is not None:

+                "DSv4.1 specialized decode: the FFN launch for layers with %s", why
+            )

+            # reduces it on the steps that keep vLLM's path.
+            attn.wo_b.reduce_results = False

+        # residual arrives settled: the embedding, or after the Engram write.
+        settled = first or layer.engram is not None

+            layer,
+            weights,
+            ffn_only=False,
+            ratio=attn.compress_ratio,
+            index=attn.indexer is not None,
+            swa_key=attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix,
+            comp_key=comp_key,

+

+
+    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]:
+        keys: dict[Any, None] = {}
+        for plan in self.plans.values():
+            for width in self.widths:
+                if plan.ffn_only:
+                    keys[width, "ffn"] = None

+                    for fold in plan.folds:
+                        keys[width, plan.ratio, fold, plan.index] = None
+        return list(keys)
+
+    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None:
+        self.runner.scratch(key[0])
+        if key[1] == "ffn":
+            self.runner.ffn_kernel(key[0])

+            width, ratio, fold, index = key
+            self.runner.kernels(width, ratio, fold=fold, index=index)
+
+    def launch_whole(
+        self,
+        plan: LayerPlan,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+        post_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+        res_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+        pre_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+        engram_hashes: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        engram_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None:
+        """Run a decode layer as one logical kernel."""
+        layer, runner = plan.layer, self.runner
+        attn = layer.attn
+        first = residual is None
+        # The draft's first layer takes the embedding already broadcast to the
+        # hc copies ([rows, hc, dim]), the backbone's the 2-D embedding.
+        if first and x.dim() != (3 if self.draft else 2):
+            return None
+        tensors = (x,) if first else (x, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix)
+        if not all(t is not None and t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors):
+            return None
+        fold = True
+        if first:
+            if self.draft:
+                residual, x = x, x[:, 0].contiguous()
+            else:
+                residual = x.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, layer.hc_mult, -1).contiguous()
+            pre_mix = runner.first_pre_mix(x.shape[0])
+            post_mix = res_mix = pre_mix  # unread without the fold
+            fold = False
+        elif layer.engram is not None and engram_hashes is not None:
+            residual = layer.mhc_post(x, residual, post_mix, res_mix)

+        if plan.index:

+        if plan.ratio:
+            comp = md[cast("str", plan.comp_key)]
+            kw.update(
+                topk_indices=attn.topk_indices_buffer,
+                comp_cache=_record_view(
+                    attn._compressed_kv_cache(), comp.block_size // plan.ratio
+                ),
+                comp_block_table=comp.block_table,
+            )
+        return runner.forward(
+            plan.weights,
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_mix,
+            res_mix,
+            pre_mix,
+            positions,
+            swa.slot_mapping,
+            _record_view(attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache, swa.block_size),
+            swa.decode_swa_indices,
+            swa.decode_swa_lens,
+            swa.token_to_req_indices,
+            fold=fold,
+            **kw,
+        )
+
+    def launch_ffn(
+        self,
+        plan: LayerPlan,
+        part: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        post_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        res_mix: torch.Tensor,
+        pre_mix: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None:
+        """The FFN seam, MoE and both reductions as one launch, from wo_b's
+        unreduced output after vLLM's attention."""
+        tensors = (part, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix)
+        if not all(t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors):
+            return None
+        return self.runner.ffn(plan.weights, *tensors)

+class DSV41Kernel(LayerLaunches):
+    """The backbone's decode: 384 experts, top-6, causal SWA windows."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, widths: tuple[int, ...]):
+        super().__init__(
+            vllm_config,
+            model,
+            widths,
+            experts=EXPERTS,
+            topk=TOPK,
+            ug_groups=2,
+            swa_width=SWA_WIDTH,
+        )
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
+        model, positions = self.model, step.positions
+        (
+            hidden,
+            input_ids,
+            pre_mix,
+            engram_hashes,
+            engram_mask,
+            full_num_tokens,
+        ) = model.prologue(
+            input_ids, positions, None, inputs_embeds, kwargs.get("lookback_token_ids")
+        )
+        residual = post_mix = res_mix = None
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        final_aux_recon = None
+        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
+            layer = model.layers[idx]
+            plan = self.plans.get(layer.attn.layer_id)
+            ffn = out = None
+            if plan is None:
+                # TODO: check if we should crash here
+                pass
+            elif plan.ffn_only:
+                ffn = partial(self.launch_ffn, plan)
+            else:
+                # Run entire layer
+                out = self.launch_whole(
+                    plan,
+                    hidden,
+                    positions,
+                    residual,
+                    post_mix,
+                    res_mix,
+                    pre_mix,
+                    engram_hashes,
+                    engram_mask,
+                )
+            if out is None:
+                # Run standard model implementation, with injected specialized ffn
+                out = layer(
+                    hidden,
+                    positions,
+                    input_ids,
+                    pre_mix,
+                    post_mix,
+                    res_mix,
+                    residual,
+                    engram_hashes,
+                    engram_mask,
+                    decode_ffn=ffn,
+                )
+            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix = out
+            aux_recon = model.after_layer(
+                idx,
+                hidden,
+                residual,
+                post_mix,
+                res_mix,
+                full_num_tokens,
+                aux_hidden_states,
+                replay=False,
+            )
+            if aux_recon is not None:
+                final_aux_recon = aux_recon
+        return model.epilogue(
+            hidden,
+            positions,
+            input_ids,
+            pre_mix,
+            post_mix,
+            res_mix,
+            residual,
+            aux_hidden_states,
+            final_aux_recon,
+            self.layer_end > self.embed_layer,
+            full_num_tokens,
+            replay=False,
+        )
+

+class DSV41DraftKernel(LayerLaunches):
+    """The DSpark draft's decode: the draft's own routing and non-causal SWA
+    rows, over the draft head's layers."""
+
+    draft = True
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, model, widths: tuple[int, ...]):
+        experts, topk = draft_routing(vllm_config)
+        super().__init__(
+            vllm_config,
+            model,
+            widths,
+            experts=experts,
+            topk=topk,
+            ug_groups=DRAFT_UG_GROUPS,
+            swa_width=draft_swa_width(vllm_config),
+        )
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, input_ids, inputs_embeds, **kwargs) -> Any:
+        model, positions = self.model, step.positions
+        hidden, input_ids, full_num_tokens = model.prologue(
+            input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds
+        )
+        residual = post_mix = res_mix = pre_mix = None
+        for idx in range(self.embed_layer, self.layer_end):
+            layer = model.layers[idx]
+            plan = self.plans.get(layer.attn.layer_id)
+            out = None
+            if plan is not None:
+                out = self.launch_whole(
+                    plan, hidden, positions, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix
+                )
+            if out is None:
+                out = layer(
+                    hidden, positions, input_ids, pre_mix, post_mix, res_mix, residual
+                )
+            hidden, residual, post_mix, res_mix, pre_mix = out
+        return model.epilogue(

+def _ffn_only(layer) -> str | None:
+    """Why this layer's attention seam and attention stay on vLLM's path, which
+    leaves it the FFN launch, or None when it runs whole."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.rocm import DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+
+    attn = layer.attn
+    if attn.compressor is not None and attn.indexer is None:
+        return "a compressor without an indexer"
+    if attn.indexer is not None and not isinstance(
+        attn.indexer, DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+    ):
+        return f"a {type(attn.indexer).__name__}"
+    if attn.compress_ratio not in (0, 1, 2):
+        return f"compress ratio {attn.compress_ratio}"
+    if attn.kv_mxfp8 or attn.kv_cache_dtype != "fp8_ds_mla":
+        return f"a {attn.kv_cache_dtype} KV cache"
+    return None
+

+def _skip_layer(layer, experts: int, topk: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this layer keeps vLLM's path for every step, or None when it takes a
+    launch (whole or FFN only: ``_plan_layer`` picks which)."""

+        return "sequence-parallel layer"
+    if not layer.fuse_seam_norm:

+        ffn.shared_experts is None

+        or ffn.n_activated_experts != topk
+        or ffn.routed_scaling_factor != 1.5
+        or ffn.swiglu_limit != 10.0

+        )
+    return None

+RECORD = 584  # an fp8_ds_mla KV record: 576 data bytes, 8 scale bytes
+SWA_WIDTH = 128  # a causal decode token's window slots
+MAX_ROWS = 48  # the kernels' step rows at most: 8 requests x (1 + 5 DSpark drafts)
+EXPERTS = 384  # the backbone's routed experts, top-TOPK of them a token
+TOPK = 6

+def draft_routing(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """The DSpark draft's routed experts and top-k (128 / 3 on V4.1-Flash)."""
+    config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+    return (
+        getattr(config, "dspark_n_routed_experts", 0) or EXPERTS,
+        getattr(config, "dspark_num_experts_per_tok", 0) or TOPK,
+    )

+def draft_swa_width(vllm_config) -> int:
+    """The DSpark draft's SWA rows: a block's non-causal window, not a causal
+    decode token's."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.compressor_utils import (
+        get_dspark_swa_index_width,
+    )
+
+    config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+    speculative = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    assert speculative is not None
+    return get_dspark_swa_index_width(
+        config.sliding_window, speculative.num_speculative_tokens
+    )

+def _widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """The configured capture sizes the kernels can serve, so a deployment
+    that asked for fewer graphs keeps them; every size at all when it asked for
+    none."""
+    sizes = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or []
+    served = tuple(s for s in sorted(sizes) if 1 <= s <= MAX_ROWS)
+    return served or tuple(range(1, MAX_ROWS + 1))

+def _refuse_config(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this config cannot run the kernels, before load."""
+    reasons = []
+    if vllm_config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size not in (2, 4):
+        reasons.append("needs tensor parallel size 2 or 4")
+    if envs.VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4:
+        reasons.append(
+            "needs AITER's A8W4 MoE (VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4 unset)"
+        )
+    try:
+        import vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.specialized_decode.mono.runner  # noqa: F401
+    except ImportError as err:
+        reasons.append(f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({err})")
+    return reasons
+

+def _refuse_model(model) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason the loaded model and this GPU cannot run the kernels. The
+    kernels read every one of the 384 experts on each rank, TP-sharded, in
+    AITER's A8W4 MXFP4 layout, from CTAs that all stay resident."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.specialized_decode.mono.runner import BLOCKS
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    reasons = []
+    if get_cdna_version() not in CDNA_VERSIONS:
+        reasons.append(f"needs CDNA{'/'.join(map(str, CDNA_VERSIONS))}")
+    cus = current_platform.num_compute_units(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    if cus < BLOCKS:
+        reasons.append(f"needs {BLOCKS} compute units, the GPU has {cus}")
+    backends = set()
+    for layer in model.layers:
+        experts = getattr(getattr(layer, "ffn", None), "experts", None)
+        routed = getattr(experts, "routed_experts", None)
+        if routed is not None:
+            backends.add(getattr(routed.quant_method, "mxfp4_backend", None))
+    wrong = backends - {Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16}
+    if wrong:
+        reasons.append(f"needs the AITER_MXFP4_BF16 MoE backend, not {wrong}")
+    return reasons
+

+def _refuse_caches(vllm_config, decode: "LayerLaunches", caches) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason the kernels cannot read these caches: they index each as
+    [blocks, block, RECORD] bytes."""
+    reasons = []
+    for name, cache in caches.items():
+        if not isinstance(cache, torch.Tensor):
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: no cache tensor")
+            continue
+        if cache.element_size() != 1:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: {cache.dtype} records, needs bytes")
+        if cache.dim() < 2:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: {cache.dim()} dims, needs [blocks, block, bytes]")
+        elif cache.stride(0) < RECORD:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: block stride {cache.stride(0)} under {RECORD}")
+    return reasons

+def _skip_swa(decode, md: dict, width: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why the SWA rows of this step are outside what the kernels read, or None
+    when they take it."""
+    for key in decode.swa_keys:
+        swa = cast("DeepseekV41ROCMAiterSparseSWAMetadata | None", md.get(key))
+        if swa is None:
+            return "layer metadata missing"
+        if swa.num_prefills != 0 or swa.num_decodes == 0:
+            return "not a decode-only step"
+        if swa.num_decode_tokens > width:
+            return "more decode tokens than rows"
+        if swa.decode_swa_width != decode.swa_width:
+            return f"SWA width {swa.decode_swa_width}"
+        if (
+            swa.decode_swa_indices is None
+            or swa.decode_swa_lens is None
+            or swa.token_to_req_indices is None
+        ):
+            return "SWA decode metadata missing"
+    return None
+

+def _skip_step(vllm_config, decode: "DSV41Kernel", width: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this step keeps vLLM's path at every layer, or None when the kernels
+    take it. One verdict for every kernel layer, from the batch the whole TP
+    group sees alike."""
+    md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    if not decode.plans:
+        return "no layer takes a launch"
+    if not isinstance(md, dict):  # a profile / dummy run, or DBO ubatches
+        return "no attention metadata"
+    replay = decode.model.decoder_replay_layers
+    if replay is not None and replay.uses_replay_batch():
+        return "replay batch step"
+    if any(md.get(k) is None for k in decode.comp_keys):
+        return "layer metadata missing"
+    return _skip_swa(decode, md, width)
+
+
+def _skip_draft_step(vllm_config, decode: "DSV41DraftKernel", width: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this draft step keeps vLLM's path at every layer. The draft reads no
+    compressed keys and never runs a replay batch, so its SWA rows decide it."""
+    md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    if not decode.plans:
+        return "no draft layer takes a launch"
+    if not isinstance(md, dict):  # a profile / dummy run, or DBO ubatches
+        return "no attention metadata"
+    return _skip_swa(decode, md, width)

+        vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+        cache.mamba_cache_dtype,
+        cache.mamba_ssm_cache_dtype,
+    )
+

+def _widths(vllm_config) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Every width a launch serves: the prepared batches, plus each captured
+    size rounded up to whole requests, up to ``PREPARED_MAX``."""
+    q = tokens_per_request(vllm_config)
+    sizes = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or ()
+    verify = {round_up(s, q) for s in sizes}
+    return tuple(sorted({*BATCHES, *(m for m in verify if m <= PREPARED_MAX)}))
+
+
+def _refuse_config(vllm_config) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this config cannot run the kernels, before load."""
+    from vllm import envs
+    from vllm.config import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    parallel, spec = vllm_config.parallel_config, vllm_config.speculative_config
+    text = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    moe = tuple(
+        getattr(text, name, None)
+        for name in (
+            "hidden_act",
+            "activation_situ_beta",
+            "activation_situ_linear_beta",
+            "num_experts",
+            "num_experts_per_token",
+            "num_expert_group",
+            "topk_group",
+            "moe_router_activation_func",
+        )
+    )
+    graphs = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+    reasons = []
+    if not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100):
+        reasons.append("needs an SM100/103 GPU")
+    if moe != MOE:
+        reasons.append(f"needs Kimi K3's SiTU MoE {MOE}, not {moe}")
+    if parallel.tensor_parallel_size not in (8, 16):
+        reasons.append("needs tensor parallel size 8 or 16")
+    if parallel.decode_context_parallel_size not in (
+        1,
+        parallel.tensor_parallel_size,
+    ):
+        reasons.append("needs decode context parallel size 1 or the TP size")
+    # The decode loop runs in forward; a compiled forward would trace it.
+    if vllm_config.compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE:
+        reasons.append("needs a forward that is not torch.compile'd")
+    # A launch only ever runs while a FULL decode graph is captured.
+    if graphs is None or graphs.decode_mode() != CUDAGraphMode.FULL:
+        reasons.append("needs FULL decode CUDA graphs (not enforce-eager)")
+    if spec is not None:
+        if spec.method != "dspark":
+            reasons.append(f"needs the DSpark speculative method, not {spec.method}")
+        if spec.enable_adaptive_verification:
+            reasons.append("needs adaptive verification off")
+        if spec.num_speculative_tokens > MAX_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS:
+            reasons.append(f"needs at most {MAX_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS} draft tokens")
+        if envs.VLLM_KIMI_K3_AUX_ATTN_RES_STREAM:
+            reasons.append("needs the AttnRes aux stream off while speculating")

+    # maintains neither other cache dtypes nor ReplaySSM / RecoverSSM records.
+    if kda_dtypes(vllm_config) != KDA_STATE_DTYPES:
+        reasons.append(
+            "needs a BF16 KDA conv state and an FP32 recurrent state "
+            "(--mamba-cache-dtype)"
+        )
+    if vllm_config.cache_config.use_replayssm or (
+        vllm_config.cache_config.use_kda_recoverssm
+    ):
+        reasons.append("needs ReplaySSM / RecoverSSM off (--use-replayssm)")
+    return reasons

+def _refuse_model(backbone) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason the loaded backbone cannot run the kernels."""
+    reasons = []
+    hidden = getattr(backbone.config, "hidden_size", None)
+    if hidden != HIDDEN_SIZE:
+        reasons.append(f"needs hidden size {HIDDEN_SIZE}, the model has {hidden}")
+    if not getattr(backbone, "num_attn_res_blocks", 0):
+        reasons.append("needs the backbone's AttnRes blocks")
+    return reasons

+    """Every reason the prepared cores cannot compile against these caches: a
+    KDA layer's states are kept in place, and an MLA layer's KV is indexed as
+    one contiguous tensor."""
+    reasons = []
+    for name, kind in kernel.cache_kinds.items():
+        cache = caches.get(name)
+        tensors = [cache] if isinstance(cache, torch.Tensor) else list(cache or ())
+        if kind == "kda":

+            if dtypes != KDA_STATE_DTYPES:
+                reasons.append(f"{name}: KDA states {dtypes}, needs {KDA_STATE_DTYPES}")
+        elif not tensors:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}: no MLA KV cache")
+        elif not tensors[0].is_contiguous():

+    # warm-up run before each capture all run vLLM's path.

+    refuse_model=_refuse_model,
+    refuse_caches=_refuse_caches,
+    skip_step=_skip_step,
+    build=_build,

+"""The layout every MonoKernel's error words and fault hook follow.
+
+A rank's health words: a header whose word FAILED is set once any of its
+in-kernel waits gave up (sticky: a failed rank stays failed, and its later waits

+region id, pair index, tag, seen tag, CTA, clock, pad).

+of the output rank's peer buffer. A rank whose wait gives up writes its word
+there, drains the store, then sets FAILED, so nothing it stores later can
+overtake the flag. The runner reads these words after every step.
+"""

+

+PEER_HEAD = 256
